note: Independent re-judgment at HEAD against RFC 7999 Section 4 ('Without an explicit configuration directive set by the operator, network elements SHOULD NOT discard traffic destined towards IP prefixes that are tagged with the BLACKHOLE community.'). Verified blackholeRouteTypeForBest/blackholeRouteType (rib_blackhole.go) return routetype.Type(0) when unconfigured or when no community is agreed, and filter_modify/match.go::matchCond.matches fires only on explicitly configured communities. Positives assert exact routetype.Type(0) on both rails for an unconfigured peer (TestBlackholeNotStampedWithoutAgreement) and an authorized peer with no agreed community (TestBlackholeNotStampedWhenNoCommunityAgreedButAuthorizationExists), plus FilterAccept with zero Sets when modify matches only 65001:100 (TestBlackholeCommunityLeavesNextHopAloneWithoutAgreement). Negative proves the counter-case: with explicit match community blackhole configured, filter_modify rewrites next-hop (TestBlackholeCommunityRewritesNextHopWhenAgreed). Q1-Q4 pass.
